context: A teacher and student review the school website together
purpose: Teach: メールアドレス/開示/閲覧/オプション/機種/無線/等々/目次

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: じゃあ、学校のサイトを一緒に見てみましょう。まずトップの目次から確認しますね。
lines.en: Alright, let's look at the school website together. First, let's check the table of contents at the top.
lines.style: Calm teacher voice guiding a student through a webpage review session.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。あ、ここに「保護者向け閲覧ページ」ってありますけど、これって誰でも見られるんですか?
lines.en: Okay. Oh, there's a 'parent viewing page' here — can anyone see it?
lines.style: Curious teenage student asking a polite but inquisitive clarifying question.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいえ、登録したメールアドレスでログインした人だけです。個人情報の開示には注意が必要なので。
lines.en: No, only people who log in with a registered email address. We have to be careful about disclosing personal information.
lines.style: Measured explanatory tone emphasizing privacy rules and digital responsibility carefully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど。あと、スマホで開くと表示が崩れるんですけど、機種によって違うんですかね?
lines.en: I see. Also, when I open it on my phone, the layout breaks — does it depend on the device model?
lines.style: Slightly frustrated teen voice describing a real technical problem she encountered.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうなんです。古い機種だと崩れることがあって、無線LANの速度も影響しますよ。
lines.en: Exactly. Older models sometimes break the layout, and Wi-Fi speed also affects it.
lines.style: Knowledgeable but approachable teacher tone explaining technical limitations to a student.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ、設定のオプションでフォントサイズとか変えられたら便利ですね。
lines.en: Then it would be convenient if we could change things like font size in the settings options.
lines.style: Bright suggestive teen voice offering a thoughtful user-experience improvement idea.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい意見ですね。ダークモード、文字拡大、読み上げ機能等々、生徒の声を業者に伝えてみます。
lines.en: That's a good point. Dark mode, larger text, read-aloud features, and so on — I'll pass the students' feedback to the vendor.
lines.style: Encouraging warm tone praising the student's input and promising follow-up action.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます!じゃあ私、目次に戻ってもう一回ざっと見てみますね。
lines.en: Thank you! Then I'll go back to the table of contents and skim through it once more.
lines.style: Cheerful grateful teen voice wrapping up with proactive follow-through energy.
